items.title: Hridoy’s discipline ensures dream day at Wanderers
items.summary: Towhid Hridoy hardly put a foot wrong after his two dismissals in the Mirpur Test, and on Sunday he demonstrated his growing mental strength by pacing his innings masterfully to score his second Test century. He became only the second Bangladesh batter after Mahmudul Hasan Joy to score a hundred in South Africa.

items.summary: A heroic rescue mission by Towhid Hridoy came to a heartbreaking end on the final delivery of the opening day as Bangladesh reached 327 for 6 against South Africa in the first Test at the Wanderers Stadium on Sunday.
